judgement.summary: The transcript is heavily garbled throughout. The course structure (parts 1–3, Clarion hotel, max ten participants) partly survives, but most names (Martola, Myller, three of the four implant brands) are lost. Course titles and the target group are unreadable, a negation about the intended audience is dropped, and the course duration is wrong.
